$comment: Example MCP client configuration for ORBIT.
Replace the absolute db path below with your own. The index must already
exist; the MCP server does not index anything, it only serves an existing
index. Create one with:  orbit --db <db> init && orbit --db <db> index <path>
Requires the mcp extra:  pip install -e '.[mcp]'
If you run Orbit from a source checkout without installing, set
PYTHONPATH to the repo's src/ directory and use 'python -m orbit.mcp_server'
NOTE: MCP 2.x renamed FastMCP to MCPServer. ORBIT supports both 1.x and 2.x.
Verified against mcp 2.3.0 with a real client over stdio.

orbit_search.signature: orbit_search(query: str, limit: int = 10, language: str | None = null, path_glob: str | None = null) -> dict
orbit_search.returns: ranked passages with source_path, start_line, end_line, content_hash, both channel scores

orbit_get_chunk.returns: one passage with its full provenance and current validation state

orbit_document.returns: document metadata, language, revision, chunk count and line span

orbit_validate_citation.returns: validation state: valid | content_changed | path_missing | chunk_out_of_range | document_deleted

orbit_traverse_evidence.returns: bounded graph traversal; each step is labelled explicit or inferred

orbit_compare.signature: orbit_compare(query_a: str, query_b: str, limit: int = 5) -> dict
orbit_compare.returns: two result sets side by side with citations, plus shared/unique chunk ids

orbit_status.returns: index statistics, embedding provider and a freshness summary

$security_note: Indexed documents are UNTRUSTED DATA. Every tool response carries an
'untrusted_content_note' field stating that retrieved passages are data,
not instructions. ORBIT never executes content found in indexed documents.
A retrieved passage may contain text like 'IGNORE ALL PREVIOUS INSTRUCTIONS'.
That text is stored and returned verbatim, because suppressing it would make
ORBIT a worse search engine. The mitigation is provenance: every passage is
attributable to a file, line range and hash, so an agent can check it before
